```{r libraries, results='hide', warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, echo = FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
library(patchwork)
library(kableExtra)
library(mgcv)

library(scoringutils)
library(hubUtils)
library(hubEnsembles)
library(hubData)
```

# Data
```{r}
state_wis <- read.csv("C:/Projects/ForecastEvaluation/Data/state-scoring/state_wis.csv")
standard_wis <- read.csv("C:/Projects/ForecastEvaluation/Data/standard-scoring/standard_wis.csv")
state_wis = state_wis |> rename(state_wis = wis)
```

```{r}
complete_wis <- state_wis %>%
  left_join(standard_wis, by = intersect(colnames(state_wis), colnames(standard_wis)))

complete_wis$relative_wis <- complete_wis$state_wis / complete_wis$wis
complete_wis = complete_wis |> select("location", "target_end_date", "horizon", "reference_date",  "model_id", "target", "wis",  "state_wis",    "relative_wis")

complete_wis <- complete_wis %>%
  filter(wis > 0)
```

# NA stuff
```{r}
# sum(is.na(complete_wis)) 
# na <- complete_wis %>%
#   filter(if_any(everything(), is.na))
# 
# table(na$location)
# table(na$target_end_date)
# table(na$model_id)
```

```{r}
complete_wis = na.omit(complete_wis)

complete_wis$model_id <- droplevels(as.factor(complete_wis$model_id))
complete_wis$location <- droplevels(as.factor(complete_wis$location))
```

# Model effects
```{r}
model <- gam(
  log(wis) ~ s(model_id, bs = "re") + 
    s(location, bs = "re"),
  family = gaussian(),
  data = complete_wis
)

summary(model)
```

```{r}
coefs <- coef(model)

model_coefs <- coefs[grepl("model_id", names(coefs))]
head(model_coefs)

location_coefs <- coefs[grepl("location", names(coefs))]
head(location_coefs)
```

```{r}
model_names <- levels(complete_wis$model_id)
location_names <- levels(complete_wis$location)

model_effects <- data.frame(
  model_id = model_names,
  effect = as.numeric(model_coefs)
)

location_effects <- data.frame(
  location = location_names,
  effect = as.numeric(location_coefs)
)

knitr::kable(model_effects |> arrange(effect)) 

knitr::kable(location_effects |> arrange(effect))
```

# Figure 2
```{r, fig.height=20, fig.width=20}
temp2a <- model_effects %>%
  arrange(-effect) %>%
  mutate(model_id = factor(model_id, levels = model_id))

fig2a <- ggplot(temp2a, aes(x = effect, y = model_id)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, color = "steelblue") +
  labs(x = "Effect (log WIS)", y = "Model") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 17),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 17)  
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "top") + geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 0), col = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1.2)
```

```{r}
temp2b <- location_effects %>%
  arrange(-effect) %>%
  mutate(location = factor(location, levels = location))

fig2b <- ggplot(temp2b, aes(x = effect, y = location)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, color = "coral") +
  labs(x = "Effect (log WIS)", y = "Location") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 17),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 17)  
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "top") + geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 0), col = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1.2)
```

```{r, fig.height=15, fig.width=20}
fig2a + fig2b + plot_layout(ncol = 2, widths = c(0.4, 0.6))
```

```{r}
png("Figures/figure2.png", width = 1920, height = 1440)
(fig2a + fig2b + plot_layout(ncol = 2, widths = c(0.4, 0.6)))
dev.off()
```
